hot_darts.name: Borgna, Andrew
hot_darts.team: Put It On Sam's Brother's Tab

predictions: As with most recent seasons, the amount of stuff that goes into the week 1 newsletter prevents me from having enough space to include both the season-long and the weekly picks. But I still do them both, and then report the week 1 results to you guys here, so that we have a full season of picks. And it was rough start for me (and somehow, especially in the top four divisions where I was only 6-6). I sit at a moderate 15-9 after week 1 (with one more dumped to a forfeit), and I need to step it up a bit. == Two 1-0 teams ==

Match of the week: (E Div.) Dirty Darts Done Dirt Cheap @ Cheap Shots. Nobody in the RDL scored more points than either of these two in week 1, and now the winner of this showdown will be in a super strong position at the top of E. And as great as the Cheapies looked in their opener, I still think E is a brief stop on the Dirty Darts' climb. 15-9.

Match #2: (F Div.) Duck Duck Groove @ That's What She Said. These two lead F in points, ASPs, and probably now expectations. The newly-re-Som'ed Ducks were my preseason picks here in F, and it's not time to jump off the train just yet. Duck Duck Win #2, 14-10.

Match #3: (A Div.) Lunatic Fringe @ Show Me Your Tips. In week 1, Show Me took out Talladega Flights. If they can do it again tonight, they will immediately announce their presence in the A title chase. But… Fringe is deep and talented, and I have to go their way. 15-9.

Match #4: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ The Dartifacts. It took exactly one night for The Dartifacts to match their spring win total, and that win was a big one. We Throw It, however, got their own clutch win. Can We Throw It take a road match?? Sure, 13-11.

Match #5: (C Div.) The Outlaws @ Darty Sanchez. Just a massive win for Sanchez out of the gate last week, but the problem tonight is that it looks like The Outlaws might well be exactly The Outlaws I described in the preseason predictions. The Outlaws are nasty, 15-9.

Match #6: (G Div.) Heart of Dartness @ 21 Dart Salute. Salute got a huge win over the Knights last week, while Dartness won the team's first-ever RDL match. I think Salute might have a little somethin', 14-10.

Match #7: (E Div.) Runs with Corks @ Rippin Darts. Dramatic wins last week have eked these two in the lead half, and somebody is set to pop off a 2-0 start! Of course the Corks pop off, but only 13-11.

Match #8: (D Div.) Liquor Possee @ Rif Raf. I will admit that these teams both surprised me in the opener, pulling in solid wins. Not entirely sure which team to trust yet… I'll take Rif Raf, I think, 14-10. == Two 0-1 Teams ==
Match #9: (E Div.) Death Throw @ She-nanigans. Very narrow misses in week 1 for these two, and DT is probably still wondering how they didn't win. I think DT partially erases that memory, 15-9.

Match #10: (C Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ Village Idiots. Two pretty close losses to very good teams last week, so this will be a tough 0-2 start for whoever falls tonight. I'll go Idiots here, in 1001.
Match #11: (G Div.) Dart Knights @ Bright side of Flights. Oh, look, the Knights re-added Terron Amos. Color me shocked. I'm thinking that eliminates any question I had had here. Knights, 15-9.

Match #12: (D Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Menace 2 Sobriety. This one feels very much like an early preview of the tournament 4v5 quarter- final. I guess I'll go with Ton 80, but with little conviction. 13-11.

Match #13: (G Div.) Triple Shot @ I Got Your 6. Ok, clearly, I had too big of a vision for Triple Shot in this race. Oops. And now that Got Your 6 has actually Got Your 10, they'll go out and get a 15-9.
Match #14: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ Coach's Into Enya. Bit of a rough start here, but I think the Shooters turn it around a bit, 14-10.
Match #15: (E Div.) Bangin The Wire @ Sharky's Machine. Don't be fooled by the Machine's first loss. They rebound here, 15-9.
Match #16: (A Div.) Talladega Flights @ Double In Stumble Out. Well, this is a home match for Stumble, at least… Talladega, 17-7.
And the remaining 9 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Brave the Elements 15, Dart Attack 9.
B Division: Darty Minds 17, Put It on Sam's Brother's Tab 7; Kilts In The Hall 13, Shooter McGavin 11; Hump Day 16, Raging 8.
C Division: Nine Lives 13, Mulligan's Mafia 11.
D Division: Irish Ton 13, Rangers 11; Wing 16, Dart Side 8.
F Division: Sofa Kings 13, Armed 11; Bottoms Up 15, Nein Mark 9.
